name: hono-auth-gateway
description: Cloudflare Workers authentication gateway: Better Auth on D1, with immediate session revocation

scripts.dev:sync: doppler secrets download --no-file --format env --project auth --config dev > .dev.vars
scripts.dev:remote: doppler run -- wrangler dev src/index.ts --config config/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:staging: doppler run --project auth --config stg -- wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: doppler run --project auth --config prd -- wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:doppler: doppler run -- wrangler deploy src/index.ts --config config/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply in8-auth-sessions --remote --config config/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply in8-auth-sessions --local --config config/wrangler.toml
